auth.title: Connect your account
auth.description:
1. Log in at [afvalcontainer.antwerpen.be]({url}) and open **Saldo**.
2. Press **F12** → **Network** tab → reload the page (**F5**).
3. Right-click the first request (**saldo**) → **Copy** → **Copy as cURL**.
4. Paste it below.

A copied `Cookie:` header or a cookie-editor JSON export works too. Only the session cookies are kept; everything else is thrown away.

data_description.login_data: The copied cURL command, Cookie header or cookie export.

Leave the threshold empty to use the site's minimum balance (currently € {minimum}).
